reference.source: Swiss study of 645 heart and stroke transfers (RESEARCH.md section 4)

road_model.note: free-flow, no traffic; traffic would lower the break-even

how_to_read: Road distance above which the aircraft's typical time beats the ambulance's. The study measured real missions, where the helicopter flies in from its base.

metrics.name: Helicopter beats ambulance above this road distance (miles)
metrics.note: Our time model, helicopter flying in 13.0 mi from its base, against the Swiss study's 32 miles. With the helicopter already at the pick-up pad: 10.0 mi. Road times have no traffic. Our model finds the helicopter faster at shorter distances than the study did, so it probably favors air: real missions spend longer at the bedside and on the pad than our labeled assumptions. Read air times as optimistic.

verdict: Our model finds the helicopter faster at shorter distances than the study did, so it probably favors air: real missions spend longer at the bedside and on the pad than our labeled assumptions. Read air times as optimistic.
